title: The Poles: real-animal videos wait for the end of the story
kaylee: No video after each chapter: the stamp goes straight back to the globe and the next picture. Once the whole story is told, a movie ticket ends the trail and Sparkle says "Movie time! Let's see the real animals from our story!"
